args.assumptions: Required land = 30 MW x 2 ha/MW = 60 ha (960 cells of 0.0625 ha). Slope from dem via Horn method in degrees; suitable if slope <= 5 degrees. Cropland (1) and scrub (2) only. DEM has no -9999 cells (nodata count 0), so no cells were excluded for missing elevation. Protected areas: A buffered 150 m, B buffered 400 m, rasterised on cell centres (all_touched false); union excluded. Line distance computed from cell centres to the 132 kV grid_line; max distance is about 1828 m, so every cell is within the 5 km limit. Parcels are 8-connected (18 patches; largest 933 cells = 58.3125 ha). Not feasible because 58.3 ha < 60 ha, so yield is set to 0 per the brief. suitable_area_ha is the total suitable area across all patches (3759 cells). The clear-sky yield was not computed since the site is infeasible.

Required land = 30 MW x 1.6 ha/MW = 48 ha. Slope limit applied as slope <= 7 degrees (Horn slope on the 25 m DEM). DEM has no -9999 cells, so no nodata masking was needed. Suitable land cover = cropland (1) and scrub (2) only. Protected areas (EPSG:4326) reprojected to EPSG:32630; A buffered 250 m and B buffered 600 m, rasterised with cell-centre inclusion (the buffers include the protected areas themselves). Line distance limit 5000 m applied to cell centres; the grid_line (reprojected to EPSG:32630) lies at most ~1.83 km from any cell, so the limit is not binding. Parcels are 8-connected. Yield is the pvlib clear-sky (Ineichen) annual figure, an upper bound, for 30 MW at 30 degree fixed tilt and PR 0.80, not a bankable yield. Feasibility: largest parcel 198.19 ha >= 48 ha.

Inputs: dem, landcover, protected_areas and grid_line all share EPSG:32630 with 25 m cells, so no reprojection was needed; no invalid protected-area geometries were reported. DEM sentinel -9999 (808 cells) declared no-data before slope (Horn, degrees); cells touching no-data are excluded by the slope tool. Slope <= 5 deg. Landcover classes 1 (cropland) and 2 (scrub) only. Protected-area buffer 300 m applied to both designation A and B features, buffered polygons rasterized with cell-centre test, and buffer cells excluded. Line distance: max 1828 m across the grid, so the 8 km (8000 m) limit excludes nothing; cell-centre test used. Requirement: 50 MW x 2 ha/MW = 100 ha = 1,000,000 m2, against largest 8-connected parcel of 57.94 ha (15 patches), so not feasible; yield set to 0 per the brief (clear-sky estimate not run). Brief's stated parameters used; no conflicting documents were found (readme only lists layers).

Required land = 30 MW x 2 ha/MW = 60 ha. Slope limit 5 deg (Horn slope, degrees, from dem; dem has no -9999 cells so no nodata masking was needed). Suitable land cover = cropland (1) and scrub (2). Protected-area polygons had one self-intersection, repaired with fix_geometry before buffering. Both designations A and B buffered 300 m (300 m = 12 cells at 25 m). Buffer and line distance judged at cell centres. HV line (132 kV) max distance 8000 m; all grid cells are within 1828 m of the line, so this constraint does not bind. 8-connected parcels. Clear-sky yield set to 0 because the largest parcel (57.94 ha) is below the 60 ha required, so the site is infeasible. The 234.0 ha suitable area is the total across all 15 parcels, not a single site. No clear-sky yield was computed.

Required land = 50 MW x 4 acres/MW = 200 acres = 80.94 ha. Buffers: 500 ft = 152.4 m (designation A), 1300 ft = 396.24 m (designation B), 3 mi = 4828.03 m to the 132 kV line. Suitable cells: slope <= 8% (Horn slope, percent) AND land cover cropland (1) or scrub (2) AND centre outside the A/B protected areas and their buffers AND centre within 3 mi of the line. The DEM has no -9999 cells and no nodata, so no cells were excluded for missing elevation; the slope-edge treatment follows the tool. The line-distance constraint was non-binding (max distance on grid 1828 m). Parcels are 8-connected; largest parcel is 53.0 ha (21 patches), below the 80.94 ha required, so the site is infeasible and yield is set to 0. Clear-sky yield was not computed because the brief specifies 0 when infeasible. Units: cell 25 m (0.0625 ha).

Required land = 50 MW x 4 acres/MW = 200 acres = 80.94 ha. Buffers: 650 ft = 198.12 m (A), 1650 ft = 502.92 m (B), applied to the reprojected EPSG:32630 polygons and judged at cell centres. Line limit 5 mi = 8046.72 m; max distance from the grid to the line is 1827.7 m, so the line constraint excludes nothing. Slope computed in percent (Horn) from the DEM and tested <= 8%. DEM nodata is declared -9999 but no cells carry it (min 511.7 m), so no cells were excluded for missing elevation. Suitable land cover = cropland (1) and scrub (2). Protected-area polygons themselves are excluded as well as their buffers. Largest parcel uses 8-connected cells (18 patches; largest 52.81 ha) and is below the 80.94 ha required, so the site is not feasible and clear-sky yield is reported as 0 per the brief. The unbuffered clear-sky yield was not computed for this reason. Suitable area 195.75 ha is the total across all patches, not a single parcel. Note: the task brief is the only specification; no conflicting documents were found.

Required land = 50 MW x 2 ha/MW = 100 ha. 8 km line limit = 8000 m; 300 m buffer = 300 m (both designations A and B, buffered by the same distance). Suitable = slope <= 5 deg (Horn slope from DEM, no nodata cells in DEM so no cells lost to nodata) AND landcover in {1 cropland, 2 scrub} AND cell centre not inside any protected area (A or B) or its 300 m buffer AND cell-centre distance to the 132 kV line <= 8000 m. Vector layers reprojected from EPSG:4326 to EPSG:32630. Protected-area buffer and line distance judged at cell centres. Largest parcel by 8-connectivity. Clear-sky yield from the pvlib tool (Ineichen, upper bound, not bankable) for 50 MW, 30 deg fixed tilt, PR 0.80. The line lies within 1.6 km of all cells, so the distance criterion excluded nothing. DEM nodata -9999 was already declared in the file; no further nodata cells found.

Required land = 30 MW x 2 ha/MW = 60 ha. Slope 3 deg max (Horn slope, degrees), with dem -9999 declared nodata; cells touching nodata excluded by slope tool. Landcover 1 (cropland) and 2 (scrub) only. Protected-area buffers: 250 m around designation A (PA-1, PA-3), 600 m around designation B (PA-2), cell-centre rule; buffered zones rasterised by cell centre. Required land = 80 MW x 2 ha/MW = 160 ha. Slope limit 3 degrees (Horn slope from dem, ≤3 kept). Suitable land cover = cropland (1) and scrub (2) only. Protected_areas had one self-intersecting polygon (PA-2, designation B), repaired with fix_geometry before buffering. Buffers: A = 200 m, B = 500 m, applied to the protected polygons; a cell is excluded if its centre falls inside the polygon or its buffer. Line distance limit 10 km, judged at cell centres (max distance to the 132 kV line in the grid is ~1.6 km, so this criterion excludes nothing). The DEM declares -9999 as nodata but contains no such cells, so no cells were excluded for missing elevation. Cell area 0.0625 ha (25 m grid). Parcels are 8-connected. Clear-sky yield set to 0 because the largest parcel (71.19 ha) is below the 160 ha required, so the plant is not feasible. The readme's landcover legend was used as written; no conflicting documents were found.

Required land = 30 MW x 5 acres/MW = 150 acres = 60.70 ha. Slope limit 5 percent, computed as percent (Horn method) on the 25 m DEM; slope <= 5 is suitable. Buffers: 650 ft = 198.12 m around designation A (PA-1, PA-3), 1300 ft = 396.24 m around designation B (PA-2); cells are excluded when their centre falls inside a buffer or the protected polygon. Line limit 6 mi = 9656.06 m, judged at cell centres from the 132 kV grid_line; the whole grid lies within it, so it does not restrict cells. Buildable land cover = cropland (1) and scrub (2); forest, water and urban excluded. The DEM declares no -9999 cells (the nodata declaration step found none), so no cells were excluded for missing elevation and no neighbour-of-nodata erosion was applied. All layers are already in EPSG:32630 so no reprojection was needed; no invalid protected-area geometries. Parcels are 8-connected; largest parcel 68.0 ha across 15 patches. Clear-sky yield from the pvlib Ineichen upper-bound tool at 30 MW, 30 degree tilt, PR 0.80: 56.5 GWh/yr, an upper bound and not a bankable estimate.

Inputs: DEM and landcover in EPSG:32630 (120x120, 25 m cells, no nodata cells found, so no cells excluded for missing elevation). Protected areas and HV line (EPSG:4326) reprojected to 32630. Conversions: 800 ft = 243.84 m (A buffer); 2000 ft = 609.6 m (B buffer); 6 mi = 9656.064 m (line distance); 4 acres/MW x 30 MW = 120 acres = 48.56 ha required. Slope computed in percent (Horn) and kept where <= 8%. Landcover kept only cropland (1) and scrub (2). Buffers applied to designation A (2 features) and B (1 feature) and rasterised with cell-centre rule; cells with centre inside A or B buffer excluded. Line distance: all cells lie within 1591 m of the line, so the 6-mile limit excludes nothing. Parcel connectivity 8-connected: 13 patches, largest 191.56 ha. Feasibility: largest parcel exceeds 48.56 ha. Yield: pvlib clear-sky (Ineichen) upper bound at 30 MW, 30 deg tilt, PR 0.80; not a bankable figure. No conflicting documents were present (readme only).

Required land = 50 MW x 5 acres/MW = 250 acres = 101.17 ha. Buffers: 500 ft = 152.4 m around designation A, 2000 ft = 609.6 m around designation B, applied as vector buffers then rasterized with cell-centre rule. Line limit 3 mi = 4828.03 m, tested at cell centres (all cells lie within 1591 m of the 132 kV line, so this does not bind). Slope computed from dem after declaring -9999 as no-data (1242 cells); Horn slope in percent, cells touching no-data are excluded, slope <= 5% kept. Land cover: cropland (1) and scrub (2) only. All layers share EPSG:32630 and 25 m cells, so no reprojection was needed; protected_areas had no invalid geometries. Largest parcel is 8-connected (68.0 ha, 19 patches in total). Feasibility fails since 68.0 ha < 101.17 ha, so yield is reported as 0 per the brief. The clear-sky yield tool was not run for the 50 MW case because the brief sets it to 0 when infeasible. No conflicting documents were found; readme.txt only lists the layers.

Inputs: DEM and landcover are both 25 m grids in EPSG:32630 with no nodata cells, so no sentinel needed masking and no cells were excluded for missing elevation. All layers share the CRS, so no reprojection. The protected_areas layer had one self-intersecting polygon (PA-2, designation B), repaired with fix_geometry before buffering. Conversions: 650 ft = 198.12 m (A buffer), 1650 ft = 502.92 m (B buffer), 3 mi = 4828.03 m (line limit), 80 MW x 5 acres/MW = 400 acres = 161.87 ha required. Slope is Horn slope in percent, kept where <= 5%. Land cover allowed: 1 cropland and 2 scrub. Buffers were applied per designation and rasterized at cell centres (all_touched false). The grid line is at most 1591 m from any cell, so the 3-mile proximity rule excludes nothing. Parcels use 8-connectivity. The required land is 161.87 ha, larger than the largest parcel (68 ha), so the site is not feasible and yield is reported as 0 per the brief. Suitable area 173.06 ha is the total of all 14 patches, not a single site. No clear-sky yield was computed because the site fails feasibility.
